shared_elements: concentric circles / disc motif on or as the body
frontal symmetrical figure with outstretched limbs
justification: Both depict a schematic frontal anthropomorph whose torso/head area is dominated by a concentric-circle or disc motif, with limbs shown symmetrically and horizontal bands crossing the field — a moderately specific correspondence. But A is a single linear stick-like figure with a circular head and bent legs set among plain horizontal lines, while B is a massive block-bodied figure with a distinct carved head, facial features, arms folded across the chest and a dense field of small subsidiary motifs (eyes, spirals, belt-like bands) on the torso, so the composition and level of elaboration differ greatly.
